zumba.name: zumba
notes: Paired femur lengths .420m and tibia lengths .400m are fixed by inverse kinematics. Both shoes and outsoles contact y=0. Knees bend forward, separated from one another; the lateral stance is a grounded illustrative step, not a jump.

Both upper arms measure .285m and forearms .255m. Upper arm radii .039m are smaller than thigh radii .071m. Hands and thumbs connect to wrists; sleeves overlap shoulder/upper arm and continuous trouser volumes cover the skeleton.

Short neck enters shirt and head; head bottom1.362m leaves about.04m above shirt. Both arms/legs use identical colors, and skin paint is flat. Musical notes are symbolic. No specific choreography, impact level, age, instructor likeness or brand affiliation is promised.

bookmobile.name: bookmobile
notes: Generic bookmobile exterior derives from the accepted original coach study: continuous floor/body, closed sloping cab, four equal .42m-radius wheels at equal axle heights, suspension and front bumper.
